title: Intern, Sales, FIS University Program
description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Education Desired

High School Diploma

Job Description

Every day, our teams innovate across the world of finance. We collaborate to work smarter, while making a difference. We believe in diversity and inclusivity, giving a voice to everyone on the team. And we celebrate our success together. If you want to make an impact in fintech, we’d like to know~ Are you FIS?

Join the 2027 FIS University Summer Internship Program!

As a 2027 FIS University Program Summer Intern, you will have the opportunity to participate in team projects, social events, professional development seminars and work alongside team mentors. This is a full-time (40hrs/week) paid internship that will begin on May 31, 2027 and conclude on August 6, 2027.

About The Team

The Business Development team consists of enthusiastic individuals passionate about pursuing a career in sales or other client facing roles. We collaborate with the growth office, sales enablement, marketing and sales teams to build strategies and execute on the front line of business development. The team likes to have fun while delivering results and developing in our careers.

What You Will Be Doing

Uses various prospecting technologies to find out contact information of prospects
Leverages social media to create compelling messaging and build relationships
Qualifies leads by asking open ended questions and engaging in active listening
Executing and evaluating prospecting in outreach for optimization
Appointment setting and liaising with prospects and sales executives

What You Bring

Pursuing bachelor’s degree in relevant field of study included but not limited to Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Economics, Communications, Management, International Business, Entrepreneurship, Digital Marketing, Commerce
Rising Senior (graduating December 2027 through May 2028)
Basic proficiency with AI-enabled tools and the ability to apply them effectively to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making
Fluent in English; Strong written and verbal communication skills
Adaptability, a drive to learn, and strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work well independently and within a team

What We Offer You

Competitive, full-time paid summer internship
Opportunity to participate in projects that directly impact business value
The chance to work on some of the most challenging, relevant issues in financial services & technology
A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
Time to support charities and give back to your community
Current and future sponsorship are not available for this position*
